summary: This feature fixes resource cleanup when middleware replaces c.res, affecting multiple middleware components and the response contract, requiring architecture and design work.

steps.why: Extract structured requirements from the ticket's bug description and multi-middleware acceptance criteria.
steps.instructions: Focus on the resource cleanup contract when c.res is replaced, covering all affected middleware (etag, prettyJSON, cache, compress, timeout, jsx-renderer, secure-headers).

steps.why: Design the response body cleanup contract and the mechanism for releasing discarded bodies across middleware.
steps.instructions: Define the contract for cleanup when c.res is replaced, ensuring stream cancellation and clone() cleanup work consistently across all middleware without breaking existing behavior.

steps.why: Break down the work across affected middleware and the core response-replacement mechanism.
steps.instructions: Create stories for the core cleanup mechanism, etag fixes, prettyJSON fixes, verification of other middleware, and regression tests.

steps.why: Each story needs concrete implementation detail for the cleanup logic and test cases.
steps.instructions: Provide file plans and implementation notes for the response body cleanup mechanism, ensuring error handling doesn't break request processing.

steps.why: Ensure consistency between HLD contract design, breakdown across middleware, and low-level implementation details.
steps.instructions: Verify the cleanup contract in the HLD matches the implementation approach in each story, and test coverage aligns with all acceptance criteria.

steps.why: Pack per-ticket specs into merged_plan.md for review.
Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Scope and acceptance criteria are clearly stated in the ticket; this is a technical bug fix with defined behavior.
Test cases map directly to the seven acceptance criteria and are straightforward enough to be handled in the designer's test sections.

feedback.body:
Change the loop from quick_fix to feature_with_architecture.

Keep these steps, in this order:
- analyst with activity requirements, not inline_story
- architect, so it writes hld.md and the specs
- scrum_master, so it writes breakdown.md and the stories
- designer, so each story gets a low-level design
- critic

This change crosses middleware and the response contract, so one inline story is not enough. Do not skip the architect or the designer.
feedback.author: pavithrachandran70

change_summary: Switched from quick_fix to feature_with_architecture, adding architect, scrum_master, designer, and critic to handle the cross-middleware response contract change.

addressed.change: Changed loop to feature_with_architecture; added analyst (requirements), architect, scrum_master, designer, and critic as requested.
